tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get the current weather in a given location

location.description: The city and state, e.g. San Francisco, CA

unit.description: The unit of temperature, either 'celsius' or 'fahrenheit'

system.text: You are an AI assistant tasked with analyzing legal contracts. Answer only from the contract text the user provides, cite clause numbers, and say clearly when the contract is silent on a question.

content.text:
